description: For a website or API monitor: its security headers grade with what each missing or weak header does and how to fix it, its DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, SPF, DMARC) and the networks its addresses belong to, its page fingerprint (Business: title, external script hosts, and the latest change waiting to be accepted) and the recent header and DNS changes. Settings are header_watch, dns_watch, dns_address_changes, content_watch and content_threshold on update_monitor. Free.
name: get_website_changes
title: Website changes of a monitor
